title: Provide shared conformance infrastructure and certification governance
requirements:
- Recommend regional/hosted test services, reusable validators and simulators, and mutual recognition of results
- Describe certifying authority, scope, validity and appeals, or make certification optional
- Cite health-specific test-bed examples and required capabilities
- Treat tests, reference data and validators as governed national assets with ownership and funding
- Make certificates version-scoped to what was tested
- Require nationally developed models, profiles and validation rules to be national assets in procurement
- Keep certification proportionate for smaller suppliers
- Address the operating and financing model for conformance services
